title: enhance-canary-shadow-ab-autorollback-e2e-and-observability
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Improves rollout workflows: adds e2e tests for canary/AB/shadow autorollback, enriches telemetry for rollback decisions, and hardens safety guards. No breaking API changes.
description: Fixes for ENG-4321: adds end-to-end tests and observability for canary/AB/shadow autorollback workflows. Motivation: recent incidents showed gaps in rollout telemetry and drift between controller decisions and metrics emitted by the runtime; this PR adds deterministic e2e coverage, tighter telemetry, and several safety guards to reduce false-positive rollbacks. Changes include: 1) e2e test suite that simulates canary + shadow traffic patterns and validates metric quorum/threshold logic; 2) enhanced autorollback engine that requires metric quorum across multiple detectors and applies a short confirmation window before action; 3) improved rollout traces and structured telemetry (rollback_reason, decision_window_ms, quorum_count) to aid post-mortem and dashboards; 4) minor controller bug fixes around traffic weighting during staged rollouts; 5) docs and release notes. Testing done: unit tests, integration tests, new e2e harness runs in CI with two synthetic workloads, manual smoke on staging. Rollout plan: merge to main, ship canary feature flag off by default, enable e2e in CI, promote to canary customers after 48h of telemetry. Checklist: [x] unit tests, [x] integration tests, [x] e2e tests, [x] docs updated, [x] dashboard updated. Related: ENG-5390 covers additional throttling heuristics which will be a follow-up PR.
